name: Ivan Velichko
headline: Fullstack Development, Infrastructure & Management
format: Remote · project engagements and long-term collaboration
summary: I develop frontend and backend applications and automate infrastructure and delivery workflows. Coordinated frontend development for a PaaS platform in a team of three. My experience spans blockchain applications, Kubernetes, CI/CD and production service reliability.

jobs.context: Worked with the team on blockchain ecosystem services, research prototypes and test infrastructure.

sections.title: ENEX DEX and Web3
items: Developed the ENEX DEX backend with Express.js and Docker and the frontend with React/Redux, Babel and Webpack.
Implemented Web3 authentication, transaction creation and signing, and blockchain data processing. These operations became part of the DEX user workflows.
Analyzed DeFi services including Uniswap and PancakeSwap.

sections.title: Cross-chain and research
items: Contributed to the architecture and implementation of a bridge between Enecuum and Ethereum-like networks.
Designed and tested smart contracts and contributed to architecture decisions.

Researched Chainlink VRF and developed a distributed VRF service PoC, including Solidity contracts, consumer contracts and distributed nodes. Delivered a software prototype for evaluating the approach.

sections.title: Testing and delivery
items: Built blockchain core test infrastructure with Node.js, Mocha, MongoDB and pm2.
Automated mobile UI tests with UIAutomator and Appium and worked on Telegram interface integration.
Configured CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Docker and administered test nodes. Contributed to test scenario design, vulnerability analysis and remediation.

jobs.context: Built a PaaS platform in a team of three. Colleagues developed and led the backend; DevOps was a shared responsibility.

sections.title: Frontend
items: Developed the platform frontend with TypeScript and Next.js with SSR and coordinated frontend development.
Delivered the user-facing part of the platform for working with its services.

sections.title: Infrastructure and automation
items: Worked on DevOps infrastructure with the team, using Kubernetes, Argo CD, Terraform, Ansible and CI/CD.
Wrote automation scripts for cloud operations and backend infrastructure, turning these operations into software tools.
The shared infrastructure supported repeatable delivery through CI/CD and GitOps. The FastAPI and Celery backend was developed by colleagues.

jobs.context: Automation, maintenance and development of infrastructure for commercial services.

sections.title: IaC and delivery workflows
items: Automated infrastructure and service configuration with IaC, including e-commerce and Grafana. Replaced manual e-commerce configuration rollout with a GitLab-triggered workflow, speeding up deployment of configuration changes.
Built and maintained GitLab CI and Jenkins pipelines for Python, .NET and Node.js. Worked on shared Helm chart standards and infrastructure documentation.
Deployed and maintained Kubernetes applications using Helm. Worked with GCP infrastructure and integration of its cloud services.

sections.title: Observability and reliability
items: Identified the cause of recurring Sentry outages: backups blocked disk access and Snuba consumers crashed. Configured restarts, monitoring and Grafana alerts. Sentry now operates reliably and the previous outages no longer interrupt developers.
Administered centralized ELK logging and worked on monitoring and error diagnosis.
Deployed and maintained SonarQube and automated project synchronization through the GitLab and SonarQube APIs. Shared tooling and workflows simplified onboarding of new projects.

sections.title: Services, access and protection
items: Maintained the existing Harbor image registry. Administered PostgreSQL, MSSQL and MariaDB.
Integrated LDAP for centralized access management and worked with HashiCorp Vault for secrets management.
Automated interaction with StormWall and Qrator Labs anti-DDoS services. Monitoring, alerts and documented response procedures reduced manual work during incidents.
